title: Toward Global Large Language Models in Medicine

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model accuracy on medical benchmarks (natural language inference, long-form question answering, and multiple-choice question answering) across 12 different languages to identify performance disparities between high-resource languages (e.g., English, Spanish) and low-resource languages (e.g., Swahili, Wolof, Yoruba, Zulu).
